drhp.business: The Company is engaged in dealing with and manufacturing of sugar, power, industrial alcohol, ethanol, chemicals and potable spirit, operating as an existing company incorporated on 22nd May, 1933. Its operations are cane-based and integrated: it generates renewable energy through its cogeneration facilities and has enhanced its ethanol production capacity to support the Government of India's Ethanol Blending Programme. It works closely with the farming community in its catchment areas, promoting sustainable agricultural practices and modern techniques to improve cane yield.

drhp.one_liner: Dhampur Sugar Mills Limited is a long-established Uttar Pradesh-based integrated sugarcane processor engaged in manufacturing and dealing in sugar, power, industrial alcohol, ethanol, chemicals and potable spirit.

plants.role: Registered office; the Company's manufacturing units, cogeneration facilities and ethanol capacity are located in Uttar Pradesh

risks.note: The Company has enhanced its ethanol production capacity specifically to support the Ethanol Blending Programme, so the returns on that capacity are tied to the continuation and terms of a government programme it does not control.
risks.risk: Policy dependence on the Government of India's Ethanol Blending Programme

risks.note: The Labour Codes affect the Company's operations and compliance requirements; management states it does not expect any material impact from their implementation, but the compliance burden and cost base remain exposed to how the Codes are enforced.
risks.risk: Changing labour legislation (the new Labour Codes)

risks.note: The Company encourages farmers to adopt modern agricultural techniques for reducing water consumption in sugarcane cultivation and supports rainwater harvesting and water conservation projects in its areas of operation, indicating that water is a structural constraint on its cane supply.
risks.risk: Water availability and the water intensity of sugarcane cultivation

risks.note: The Company has had to adopt measures towards achieving Zero Liquid Discharge, including installation of advanced treatment and recovery systems, to reduce and eliminate water and air pollution in the vicinity of its manufacturing units; continued compliance requires ongoing environmental investment.
risks.risk: Environmental compliance - effluent discharge and air emissions at manufacturing units

risks.note: The Company actively promotes sustainable agricultural practices among farmers through awareness programmes and capacity-building initiatives, reflecting that raw-material availability and quality rest on third-party cultivators rather than on owned estates.
risks.risk: Dependence on the farming community for cane supply and agronomic practice

risks.note: The Company depends on a skilled, motivated and engaged workforce across multiple locations and runs structured induction and continuous learning programmes; industrial relations remained cordial and harmonious during the year, but labour continuity is structural to a multi-unit seasonal operation.

The Company has adopted a Vigil Mechanism / Whistle Blower Policy to provide Directors and Employees a route to report unethical practices, fraud or violations of the Code of Conduct, with safeguards against victimisation - an explicit acknowledgement that conduct risk requires a standing control.

Mitigation rests on the Risk Management Policy and framework, whose effectiveness depends on identifying risks at an appropriate time; risk procedures are periodically reviewed and the risk-management strategy is integrated with overall business strategy and communicated throughout the organisation.
